runtime_encoding: lossless 58-bit cache-line number plus one DEMAND/FILL kind bit

neural_action_decoder.request_count: stateless event-keyed Bernoulli inverse-CDF hurdle plus common-quantile Poisson inverse-CDF excess
neural_action_decoder.targets_and_fill: guard-selected deterministic joint-class MAP or learned-scale-aware component-peak MAP, followed by the selected component mean

stochastic_decoding: stateless SHA-256 keyed hurdle/count sampling plus guard-selected deterministic joint action MAP
event_key_definition: zero-based role-local decision index plus source-visible cache-line number
captured_spp_actions_role: fill-preserving normal replay and supervised labels only
training_target: canonicalized source-SPP request count plus joint direct target and fill class as supervision only

lstm.architecture: compact chronological LSTM plus keyed hurdle/Poisson count and joint delta-component/fill decoder
lstm.stateful_training: chronological TBPTT over the complete demand/fill event sequence; hidden/cell values cross chunks and graph history is detached at chunk boundaries
lstm.inference_history: fresh state followed by complete train, guard, and evaluation chronology; guard demand callbacks select the decoder mode and evaluation demand callbacks produce the reported replay

eviction_feedback_role: raw chronological input event only; no private SPP state and no separate eviction prediction target

legacy_v15_decoder_contract.targets_and_fill: one event-keyed inverse-CDF sample from a joint mean-canonicalized delta-component by fill-class distribution

v16a_decoder_ablation.request_count_decoder_unchanged: stateless event-keyed Bernoulli hurdle plus conditional Poisson excess
v16a_decoder_ablation.joint_class_map: argmax of learned joint delta-component/fill probability with canonical tie order
v16a_decoder_ablation.component_peak_map: argmax of learned joint probability divided by learned component scale, evaluated at each component mean; not an exact Gaussian-mixture mode claim
v16a_decoder_ablation.selection_data: guard labels only; evaluation labels are never used for selection
v16a_decoder_ablation.decoder_feedback: complete learned joint-distribution expectation, unchanged from v15 training and inference

parameter_counts: measured and asserted exactly; never thresholded
